title: Extend reclamation snapshot reader parity to missing ancestry shapes
outcome: The snapshot reader resolver is regression-tested against the full target for cycles, multi-hop projectless ancestors, own-project children and orphan child markers.
acceptance: Reader-parity cases cover delegation cycles, a multi-hop chain through a projectless parent, a child with its own project_id, a child-shaped session with no delegation row and a projectless session with a delegation; compare the snapshot reader to the existing full-target/narrow-view oracle.
Relevant focused reclamation eligibility tests pass on the changed input.
